in_sanskrit.name: कपिल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kapila is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kapi’, which means black, dark, or dark-skinned. In Hindu mythology, Kapila is the name of several important figures, including Kapila Muni, the sage who is considered the founder of Jainism.

in_hindi.name: कपिला
in_hindi.meaning: सूरज के पूजारी | सूरज के प्रसादी
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Kapila can be translated to ‘the worshiper of the sun’ or ‘the one who receives the sun’s blessings’. The name is also associated with the Hindu deity Surya (the sun god) and is considered an auspicious name for a baby boy.

in_tamil.name: கபில
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Kapila can be translated to ‘dark complexion’ or ‘handsome face’. The name is also used in Hindu mythology to refer to Kapila Muni, the sage who is considered the founder of Jainism.

in_telugu.name: కపిల
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Kapila can be translated to ‘dark complexion’ or ‘handsome’. The name is also used in Hindu mythology to refer to Kapila Muni, the sage who is considered the founder of Jainism.

in_marathi.name: Kapila
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kapila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is dark in complexion, or the one who is filled with wisdom and knowledge.
